documents.rights_basis: Historical Latin of Litteras a vobis identified in Acta Sanctae Sedis 27 (1894-1895), printed pp.3-7, including its address, complete body, blessing, 2 July 1894 dating and subscription. The retained facsimile title establishes publication by 1895. United States expired publication-term basis under 17 U.S.C. 304-305, with 104A remainder where applicable and 103(b) for unchanged preexisting wording. This bounded derivative excludes one exactly identified foreign-act insertion from the normalized Vatican web transcription; it does not clear portal HTML, modern bibliography, later revisions or translations. Shared authorities and jurisdictional limits: src/sources/inventories/papal-documents-rights-v1.toml. Historical source wording is excluded from Triptych CC BY 4.0.
documents.rights_notice: Historical Latin wording is public domain in the United States; portal markup, translations and modern additions retain their separate rights.
documents.source_note: Vatican web transcription of ASS 27 (1894-1895), pp.3-7. An alien-act insertion is excluded by exact byte bounds checked against the historical facsimile. All retained wording, inline reference notes and order are unchanged. Remaining transcription errors are uncorrected; full word-for-word collation was not performed.
